name: Koi Q! ~Koi to H no Midareuchi~
source:
An angel girl falls down from the sky begging for main character's cooperation. To become a full-fledged angel she needs to help protagonist fall in love with a girl. There are three candidates to bring happiness to.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名天使少女从天而降，恳求主人公协助自己。若想成为独当一面的天使，她必须帮助主人公爱上一名少女。她要为三个候选对象带来幸福。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
